tools.name: get_page_info
tools.description: Get metadata about the page the user is currently viewing (title, description, locale, headings).

tools.name: go_to
tools.description: Navigate the browser to a page on this site by its slug or path.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List the content types available on this site (in the current page language) with the number of pages in each.

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Request a callback from the Hipcall sales team. Collects the visitor's full name, company, phone number and email address; a representative gets in touch shortly. Does not send automatically - the visitor reviews the filled form and presses the send button.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search this website full-text in the current page language. Returns title, URL and excerpt. Optionally filter by content type.

type.description: Filter by content type (e.g. Product, Feature, Integration, Partner, Blog, Sector)
